# `img` standard library

The `img` module provides a pure Edva lossless 2D `Image` buffer (contiguous
RGBA8 pixels) along with encoders and decoders for the **QOI** (Quite OK Image)
and **PNG** (RFC 2083) image formats. The PNG decoder supports all five RFC 2083
scanline filters (`None`, `Sub`, `Up`, `Average`, and `Paeth`) and 8-bit
Grayscale (`0`), RGB (`2`), Grayscale+Alpha (`4`), and RGBA (`6`) color types.

```{.dva .run}
#use img
#use io
#use str

im = img::new_rgba(8, 8, 255, 128, 0, 255)
png = img::encode_png(im)
qoi = img::encode_qoi(im)
io::out $ "PNG bytes: " + str::from_int(?png) + ", QOI bytes: " + str::from_int(?qoi)
```

## Types & function catalog

| Symbol / Function | Signature | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `img::Image` | `(width: Int, height: Int, pixels: String)` | 2D RGBA8 image buffer (`width * height * 4` bytes) |
| `img::new_rgba(w, h, r, g, b, a)` | `Int, Int, Int, Int, Int, Int => Image` | Creates a solid-color `w x h` RGBA8 image with bytes in `0..255` |
| `img::from_fn(w, h, fn)` | `Int, Int, (Int, Int => (Int, Int, Int, Int)) => Image` | Rasterizes a pixel coordinate function `(x, y => (r, g, b, a))` |
| `img::from_sampler(w, h, sampler)` | `Int, Int, (Float, Float => color::Color) => Image` | Rasterizes a normalized `[0, 1]^2` UV color sampler into an `Image` |
| `img::get_rgba(im, x, y)` | `Image, Int, Int => (Int, Int, Int, Int)` | Reads pixel `(x, y)` as `(r, g, b, a)` in `0..255` (clamped) |
| `img::get_color(im, x, y)` | `Image, Int, Int => color::Color` | Reads pixel `(x, y)` as a normalized `color::Color` |
| `img::encode_qoi(im)` | `Image => String` | Encodes an `Image` into the lossless QOI binary format |
| `img::decode_qoi(data)` | `String => < Image \| Error >` | Decodes a QOI byte string into an RGBA8 `Image` |
| `img::encode_png(im)` | `Image => String` | Encodes an `Image` into an RFC 2083 RGBA8 PNG byte string |
| `img::decode_png(data)` | `String => < Image \| Error >` | Decodes an RFC 2083 PNG byte string into an RGBA8 `Image` |
| `img::decode(data)` | `String => < Image \| Error >` | Auto-detects PNG (`\x89PNG`) or QOI (`qoif`) magic header and decodes |
| `img::load(path)` | `String => < Image \| Error >` | Reads and decodes a PNG or QOI image file from disk |
| `img::save(path, im)` | `String, Image => <>` | Writes `im` to `path` (QOI if `.qoi` extension, otherwise PNG) |
